# group by YYYY-MM
month_to_files={}
for f in internet_year_files:
    base=f.split('/')[-1]  # YYYY-MM.ext
    month=base.split('.')[0]
    month_to_files.setdefault(month, []).append(f)

print('months:', {m: sorted([x.split('.')[-1] for x in fs]) for m,fs in month_to_files.items()})

# choose txt if available else pdf
selected_paths=[]
for month, fs in sorted(month_to_files.items()):
    txt=[x for x in fs if x.endswith('.txt')]
    pdf=[x for x in fs if x.endswith('.pdf')]
    if txt:
        selected_paths.append(sorted(txt)[0])
    elif pdf:
        selected_paths.append(sorted(pdf)[0])

print('selected_paths:', selected_paths)

amounts=[]
for fpath in selected_paths:
    data=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=fpath)
    text=data.get('content','')
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', text)
    if not m:
        # try alternate spacing
        m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', text)
    if not m:
        print('No total amount found in', fpath)
        continue
    amt=Decimal(m.group(1))
    amounts.append((fpath, amt))

total=sum(amt for _,amt in amounts)

# <playbook_cite>No relevant entry — computing sum of internet .txt totals for current year>
# <uncertainty>PDF bills for this year may not have extractable totals; using .txt files with parsed 'Total Amount'.

import re
from decimal import Decimal

this_year = datetime.now().year  # year from environment
internet_txt_files = sorted([
    f for f in bills_files_listing
    if '/bills/internet/' in f and f.endswith('.txt') and os.path.basename(f).startswith(f'{this_year}-')
])
print('this_year', this_year)
print('internet_txt_files', internet_txt_files)

amounts=[]
for fpath in internet_txt_files:
    data=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=fpath)
    text=data.get('content','')
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', text)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No Total Amount found in {fpath}')
    amt=Decimal(m.group(1))
    amounts.append(amt)
    print('parsed', os.path.basename(fpath), amt)

total = sum(amounts)
print('total_internet_bills_txt_this_year', total)
len_amounts=len(amounts)
print('num_months', len_amounts)
